# QR Code Generator

`qrcode.mjs` is the unmodified MIT-licensed QR Code Generator by Kazuhiko Arase.

- Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator/blob/master/js/dist/qrcode.mjs
- Downloaded: 2026-10-11
- SHA-256: `ea91d7118a5395289170da848b7c6758b996163bfbccf312591ab65a4911b7c0`
- License: `LICENSE-qrcode.txt`

Bundled locally so creating a lobby QR needs no CDN, online QR service, npm install or internet connection. The game uses automatic QR version selection, byte mode and medium error correction. Shared links contain only the room code, never seat/host tokens.
